You {{QuoteRem|just}} HAVE to bring one back for me!|audio = FrostWave9-1.ogg|[[Professor V]] on Wave 12 ([[Frost Mode|Frost]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Frost Mystery''' is a summoner enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It has a low amount of health and fast speed. When killed, it will summon one random [[Bloated]] enemy. During the event, this was five enemies instead. ==Logbook Description== "''The Frost Mystery is considered one of the most terrifying creatures in the Frost Realm. It has an exoskeleton made of tough solid ice, while its insides contain water that cannot be frozen. According to legend, these beings are created from those who fall through frozen lakes and never resurface. The shadowy figure visible within is believed to be one of these unfortunate souls. It releases frost enemies with modifiers upon death.''" ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Frost Mystery''' is an entity with an exoskeleton made entirely out of tough, solid ice filled with water unfreezable water. Inside its torso, it contains a shadowy figure in it, which has an entirely white body. |Version 1 |The '''Frost Mystery''' is an entity with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It has an exoskeleton made entirely out of tough, solid ice filled with water unfreezable water. Inside its torso, it contains a shadowy figure in it, which has an entirely white body. }} ==Enemies Spawned== In [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, the '''Frost Mystery''' summons in one enemy from a set list. These enemies are: *[[Snowman]] (31.58% chance, 0.4 delay) *[[Frostmite]] (26.32% chance, 0.5 delay) *[[Cold Mist]] (26.32% chance, 0.7 delay) *[[Snow Minion]] (15.79% chance, 0.7 delay) During the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], the '''Frost Mystery''' summoned five random enemies from a set list, all with their own chances of being chosen. Additionally, all of them had random attributes applied to them, which also had their own odds of being chosen. It could summon the following enemies: *[[Snowy]] (30% chance, 0.1 delay) *[[Frozen]] (30% chance, 0.1 delay) *[[Snow Minion]] (30% chance, 0.1 delay) *[[Packed Ice]] (10% chance, 0.1 delay) These could spawn with the following attributes: *[[Nimble]] (35% chance) *[[Bloated]] (35% chance) *[[Health Regen]] (15% chance) *[[Aggro]] (15% chance) ==Strategy== *Early-game towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Golden Soldier]], [[Cowboy]] or [[Operator]] can be useful against it. **As these spawn in hordes, AOE towers like the [[Rocketeer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Archer]] can also be pretty effective. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} FrostMystery24.png|First version (16 December 2024 – 3 December 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FrostMysteryStun.gif|First stun animation (16 December 2024 – 3 December 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FrostMystery.png|Green variant, first version variant (11 June 2025 – 3 December 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorspeMegaFrostMystery.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, first version variant (12 March 2025 – 3 December 2025) CorpseFrostMystery.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, second version variant (3 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Valentines Crate 2026 - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Frost Mystery''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostMysteryIconIG.png|'''Frost Mystery''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The description in the [[Index]] for the '''Frost Mystery''' mentions that it is created when people fall through frozen lakes and never resurface. This is a reference to the original [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] map from the [[Frost Invasion Event]], which had a lake which players could fall through. *The '''Frost Mystery''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.84.0]] **Health increased from 40 to 50. *'''28 August 2026''' - [[v2.8.0]] **Health increased from 50 to 100 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. **Health increased from 50 to 100 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **''Icebreaker'' ability changed. ***Now summons the [[Snow Minion]] with a 15.79% chance and 0.7 delay, and [[Cold Mist]] with a 26.32% chance and 0.7 delay. ***No longer summons the [[Packed Ice]]. ***[[Snowman]] chance decreased from 34% to 31.58%. ***[[Snowman]] delay increased from 0.1 to 0.4. ***[[Frostmite]] chance decreased from 33% to 26.32%. ***[[Frostmite]] delay increased from 0.1 to 0.5. ***Summoned enemies are no longer [[Bloated]]. {{FrostMode|[[Cold Mist]]|Wave 10|Frost Mystery|Wave 12|[[Crying Angel]]|Wave 14}} {{OperationICE|[[Unstable Ice]]|Wave 17 (Easy)|hardt1 = [[Crying Angel]]|hardw1 = Wave 21 (Hard)|Frost Mystery|Wave 18 (Easy)|hardt2 = Frost Mystery|hardw2 = Wave 23 (Hard)|[[Frost Invader]]|Wave 20 (Hard)|hardt3 = [[Frost Invader]]|hardw3 = Wave 26 (Hard)}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
